theme: Which resistor drifted, from terminal measurements only
title: Hidden Chain: Minimum-Cardinality Drift From Terminal Readings
strategies: trivial: assume nothing drifted (claim zero faulty components)
greedy: curve-fit the FIRST excitation pattern alone and report the first single component (or pair) whose value reproduces it -- a real single-pattern fit that ignores cross-pattern consistency

strong: search increasing claim cardinalities, requiring the fitted value(s) to jointly reproduce EVERY shown excitation pattern at once, exploiting a second pattern that isolates a specific interior segment to rule out spurious single-pattern explanations
invalid: claim an edge index outside the netlist range (infeasible artifact)
